verdict.rationale: Proa components are typed Rust components that hold markup and rendering logic together. A template macro is validated at compile time with escaped dynamic slots (proa-gh-2). Components take compile-time-checked props (proa-docs-32), and one typed component can render HTML, Markdown and other targets (proa-docs-15, proa-docs-7). Adding signals and event handlers in the same component emits the server-rendered HTML plus the island's JavaScript (proa-gh-3). Missing for 10: evidence that styles are co-located inside the component rather than in separate stylesheets, a concrete documented example of the component syntax, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the authoring experience.
